aiguilledumidi.name: Aiguille du Midi
aiguilledumidi.slogan: A needle of granite 3,842 metres up, one cable car from the valley.
aiguilledumidi.line: Its cable car climbs from 1,035 m to 3,842 m, the highest vertical ascent of any cable car in the world.

annecypalaisisle.name: Palais de l'Isle
annecypalaisisle.slogan: A stone ship moored mid-canal, with the Thiou rushing past its prow.
annecypalaisisle.line: Dating from the 12th century, this island fortress was a prison and courthouse until the Revolution, and a prison again in World War II.

montenversmerdeglace.name: Mer de Glace
montenversmerdeglace.slogan: France's longest glacier, reached by a little red mountain train.
montenversmerdeglace.line: Since 1908 the Montenvers rack railway has carried visitors up to the Mer de Glace, the longest glacier in France.

annecychateau.name: Château d'Annecy
annecychateau.slogan: Four centuries of Alpine lords watching over the rooftops and the lake.
annecychateau.line: Its Queen's Tower dates from the 12th century and has walls over 4 metres thick; the castle served as a barracks until 1947.

annecypontamours.name: Pont des Amours
annecypontamours.slogan: A small bridge where lake, canal and gardens meet at sunset.
annecypontamours.line: Local legend says a couple who kiss on this footbridge over the Vassé canal will stay united for life.
